================================================================================
Keyword splits from a follower that could continue the word
================================================================================
b a(
---
(program (word) (keyword))

================================================================================
Keyword precedence beats the longer literal where the word token is valid
:error
================================================================================
b a-
---
(program (word) (ERROR (keyword) (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Keyword precedence beats the longer literal where the word token is not valid
:error
================================================================================
:a-
---
(program (keyword) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))
